What To Watch For

Watch how he reads the second level pre-snap. His eyes never stop moving — processing zone coverages before the ball is snapped. In zone look-off sequences, his head fakes are already advanced for his age.

Comp:Patrick Mahomes / Aaron Rodgers
The most pro-ready quarterback in the class from a mental standpoint.

What To Watch For

Watch him against press coverage — his combination of length and explosion at the line is what separates him. He doesn't just beat press, he embarrasses it. Track his route running on double moves — the sell is elite.

Comp:Julio Jones / Calvin Johnson
The best prospect in this class regardless of position.

What To Watch For

Watch his off-schedule moments — when the pocket breaks down is when Moore is most dangerous. His ability to reset his feet and still deliver an accurate deep ball while moving is rare. Track his eyes when he scrambles.

Comp:Lamar Jackson lite / Kyler Murray
The most exciting quarterback in the class. Volatile in the best way.
